			~​PSX Starter Kit~

	This collection strives to be a community driven resource
 	for developers who need PSX style low-poly models for video
	    games with authentic texturing and vertex shading.

			-Assets in Pack-

			    -Notes- 

	I plan to add to the collection at least once a month.

	​Any suggestions for new assets are welcome and encouraged.

​	If issues are found with any of the assets, or you feel 
	like you could have some input please suggest it in the 
			comments or threads.
